structure.note: One class of common stock; 784,669,191 shares were outstanding on December 31, 2025, after about $4.7 billion of Boeing shares were issued for the Spirit AeroSystems acquisition (December 8, 2025). Boeing also has 5,750,000 shares of 6.00% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock (aggregate liquidation preference $5,750 million), which convert into common stock by October 15, 2027. The proxy lists Vanguard, FMR and BlackRock as the holders above 5% of common stock.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-26-004357, filed January 30, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-096787, filed March 6, 2026; principal shareholders as of the dates in its footnotes, share count at December 31, 2025). LEADER: David Calhoun ceased to be CEO on August 8, 2024 and retired from Boeing on March 1, 2025 (per the 2025 proxy, read for the prior edition). The 2026 proxy names him only as the prior CEO in the pay-versus-performance table; he is not a director or named executive officer and is not in its ownership tables, so status is no-reported-stake. 5% HOLDERS: Vanguard and FMR report holdings as of December 31, 2025; BlackRock's 6.8% rests on a filing as of December 31, 2024 and is stale. DIVIDENDS: no common dividends were paid in 2025 (suspended since 2020). The cash-flow statement shows $331 million of "Dividends paid on Mandatory convertible preferred stock" in 2025; that is a separate line for preferred holders, so it is excluded and dividends are recorded as 0. BUYBACKS: the quoted Item 5 footnote covers the fourth quarter; for the full year the cash-flow statement has no share repurchase line, and its $34 million "Employee taxes on certain share-based payment arrangements" is tax withholding, not a buyback. STOCK COMP: $426 million is the cash-flow add-back. GEOGRAPHY: the eight regional rows sum to the reported $89,463 million total; the 737 MAX concessions reconciling line has no 2025 amount.
